include_once comm_PerDefinition.txt

// -------------------------------------------------------
// 4.6 天通卫星（GEO轨道，通信中继）
// 仅承载卫星通信链路
// -------------------------------------------------------
platform_type TIAN_TONG_SAT WSF_PLATFORM
  radar_signature SAT_SIG

  mover WSF_SPACE_MOVER
    update_interval 1 sec
    oblate_earth true
    orbital_state
      epoch_date_time sep 15 2025 00:00:00
      semi_major_axis 42164 km
      eccentricity 0.0
      inclination 0 deg
      raan 120 deg
      argument_of_periapsis 0 deg
      mean_anomaly 0 deg
    end_orbital_state
  end_mover

  // 天通链路A
  comm sat_link WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
    on
    network_name COM_MESH_NET
    add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
        channels 4
        mode "default"
          transfer_rate 16 kbits/sec      //界面配置
      end_mode
    end_medium
    
    transmitter
      frequency 11.8 GHz    //界面配置
      bandwidth 54 MHz    //界面配置
      power 40 W    //界面配置
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern SAT_SPACE_BEAM_ANTENNA
      attenuation_model none
      end_attenuation_model
    end_transmitter
    receiver
      frequency 14.2 GHz    //界面配置
      bandwidth 54 MHz    //界面配置
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern SAT_SPACE_BEAM_ANTENNA
      noise_figure 3 dB    //界面配置
    end_receiver
    internal_link script_proc
  end_comm
  
  processor script_proc WSF_SCRIPT_PROCESSOR
  end_processor
end_platform_type

// -------------------------------------------------------
// 4.7 神通卫星（GEO轨道，与天通相同，通信中继）
// 仅承载卫星通信链路
// -------------------------------------------------------
platform_type SHEN_TONG_SAT WSF_PLATFORM
  radar_signature SAT_SIG

  mover WSF_SPACE_MOVER
    update_interval 1 sec
    oblate_earth true
    orbital_state
      epoch_date_time sep 15 2025 00:00:00
      semi_major_axis 42164 km
      eccentricity 0.0
      inclination 0 deg
      raan 120 deg
      argument_of_periapsis 0 deg
      mean_anomaly 0 deg
    end_orbital_state
  end_mover

  comm sat_link WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
    on
    network_name COM_MESH_NET
    add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
      channels 4
      mode "default"
        transfer_rate 16 mbits/sec     //界面配置
      end_mode
    end_medium

    transmitter
      frequency 11.8 GHz    //界面配置
      bandwidth 54 MHz    //界面配置
      power 40 W    //界面配置
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern SAT_SPACE_BEAM_ANTENNA
      attenuation_model none
      end_attenuation_model
    end_transmitter
    receiver
      frequency 14.2 GHz    //界面配置
      bandwidth 54 MHz    //界面配置
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern SAT_SPACE_BEAM_ANTENNA
      noise_figure 3 dB    //界面配置
    end_receiver
    internal_link script_proc
  end_comm

  processor script_proc WSF_SCRIPT_PROCESSOR
      on_message
      end_on_message
  end_processor
end_platform_type
